title: Digital product roadmap and reconstruction feasibility
status: Proposed independent product design; no platform implementation or vendor procurement in this phase
recommendation: Build one AI-operated staffing platform with three role-based experiences. Own workflow decisions, policy versions and audit evidence; establish specialist services and choose one authoritative staffing record system.
planning_assumption: Start with one staffing service line, one specialty, one jurisdiction and one client/worksite group. This is a scope recommendation, not a claim the market or client has been selected.
operating_limit: AI can operate delegated administrative tasks. Licensed healthcare and education services, accountable employment/clinical decisions, contractual exceptions and financial release still need the relevant professionals and owners. The current research does not establish a zero-human company.

architecture.rule: Use one application with role-specific access initially; a native mobile app is optional later.
Agents propose or execute permitted actions through validated domain commands. The model is not the authority for payroll totals or credentials.

components: Selected ATS/CRM or minimal owned staffing core
architecture.rule: Assign one authoritative system per record class. Vendor IDs map to internal IDs; duplicate masters are not an acceptable integration design.
Provision the new operator's accounts and permitted integration scope. Amergis's accounts and datasets are not available inputs.

system_of_record_decisions.owner: Selected ATS/CRM by default; minimal owned core only if vendor criteria fail
system_of_record_decisions.boundary: Choose before implementation. Own workflow store holds IDs, state evidence and action history rather than a competing editable master.

system_of_record_decisions.records: Contract rules, requirement versions, approval policy
system_of_record_decisions.boundary: Store source, effective dates, unit, applicability, precedence and approved interpretation. An unresolved rate or rule stays unresolved.

system_of_record_decisions.owner: Restricted evidence store plus external issuing/screening sources
system_of_record_decisions.boundary: Document extraction is not verification; readiness uses person match, jurisdiction, status and freshness.
Preserve originals and amendments. Internal normalized entries reference source records and approval state.
Owned software prepares, checks and reconciles inputs. Final financial posting/release is separately authorized.

system_of_record_decisions.records: Agent actions, approvals, exceptions and reconciliation
system_of_record_decisions.boundary: Record actor, evidence, payload hash, policy/model version, idempotency key and outcome.

ats_selection_gate.default: Establish a suitable ATS/CRM for the initial pilot if it passes the integration criteria. Do not select solely because Amergis historically named a vendor.
required_evidence: Current documented read/write APIs for required records and status transitions
Permitted AI integration and customer data access under the applicable agreement
Scoped service accounts, field access and tenant isolation
Synthetic test environment or an acceptable documented test approach
Event/change support or reliable incremental reconciliation
Data export, attachments, identifiers, limits and operational support
Measured fit to the pilot journey and commercial terms
ats_selection_gate.fallback: If no candidate passes, build the minimal candidate–job–submission–assignment core for the pilot. Do not recreate an enterprise ATS feature catalog in parallel with buying one.
ats_selection_gate.vendor_status: Erecruit, Bullhorn, ADP, Certiphi, Nursys and MatterWorx are research leads or examples, not selected suppliers. No quotes, contracts or accounts have been obtained.

release_slices.name: Operating contract and vendor decisions
release_slices.build: Fix the pilot scope; define object ownership, allowed agent actions and one client requirement/rate pack.
release_slices.establish: Select ATS approach, payroll/accounting, screening/licensing and communication services; obtain permitted test access.
release_slices.exit: An explicit owner and authoritative system for each object; vendor integration gaps recorded; synthetic journey agreed.

release_slices.name: Candidate to approved placement
release_slices.build: Worker intake and consent, client requisition intake, evidence-linked matching, credential/onboarding queue and operations approvals.
release_slices.establish: A consented candidate population and real client demand; test credentials and screening packages for the chosen profession.
release_slices.exit: Synthetic duplicate, missing credential, rejection, withdrawal and approved placement cases behave correctly. No live employment decision delegated solely to a model.

release_slices.name: Assignment to reconciled money
release_slices.build: Shift confirmation, time intake/amendments, pay preparation, invoice draft and reconciliation views.
release_slices.establish: Contract-designated time source, payroll codes, billing rules, accounting connections and named financial owners.
release_slices.exit: No duplicate booking/pay batch/invoice on retries; pay and bill totals reconcile; a client invoice dispute does not automatically suppress earned-pay processing.

release_slices.name: Bounded live operation
release_slices.build: Enable approved reminders and record updates; raise task authority only after observed pilot performance.
release_slices.establish: Named exception coverage, client/worker agreements and live vendor scopes; thresholds set by accountable owners.
release_slices.exit: Measured errors, intervention rates and response times meet agreed limits; rollback, replay and escalation are exercised.

release_slices.name: Additional products and scale
release_slices.build: Multi-client programs, supplier/VMS portal, advanced analytics, native mobile or teletherapy administration only when their business lines are selected.
release_slices.establish: Additional contract/jurisdiction rules and relevant licensed services.
release_slices.exit: Each expansion has its own verified workflows, unit economics and regression cases; no assumption one client's configuration generalizes.

next_discovery_sprint.task: Turn public evidence into versioned specifications
next_discovery_sprint.deliverable: Field dictionary, permission matrix and state diagrams for requisition, submission, credential readiness, assignment, timecard and invoice.
next_discovery_sprint.completion: Every transition has actor, prerequisite, evidence, output and exception route; observed behavior is separated from proposed design.

next_discovery_sprint.deliverable: One complete candidate-to-invoice journey plus duplicate, expired credential, canceled shift, corrected timecard and credit/rebill cases.
next_discovery_sprint.completion: No real personal or client data is required; expected outcomes are explicit. This is a proposed next implementation, not completed in this phase.

next_discovery_sprint.deliverable: Versioned API/schema exports, sample payloads, scopes and limits for shortlisted services.
next_discovery_sprint.completion: Each connector has an owner, authorized scope, source specification, retry/reconciliation behavior and a documented pass/fail decision.

next_discovery_sprint.deliverable: Synthetic worker, recruiter, client, supplier and payroll walkthroughs with an approved evaluation purpose.
next_discovery_sprint.completion: Record action semantics, states, validation and exports without assuming a support-form role label equals permission.

next_discovery_sprint.deliverable: Working intake-to-placement prototype over the selected record system, with an operations exception queue.
next_discovery_sprint.completion: Run the agreed positive and negative cases before any external action authority is enabled.

not_recoverable_from_public_evidence: Amergis's private candidate pool, customer CRM and payroll or invoice transactions
Actual production table definitions, custom fields, configuration and complete permissions
Private SOPs, matching algorithms, model prompts, conversion rates and operating unit economics
Current integration mappings and complete failure/retry behavior behind authenticated services
scope_of_this_phase: Product definition and reconstruction feasibility only. No vendor outreach, registrations, procurement, authenticated portal access or live workflow implementation.
